claims.evidence: No import documentation, shipping label, or VIN/engine tag visible in the photo; origin cannot be confirmed from a single close-up shot.
No video of the engine running or bench-test clip showing the intake/filter housing functioning; only a static close-up is available.
Engine knock is an audible/functional trait of the whole engine, not something a photo of an air intake housing can show; no audio/video provided.
No odometer photo or vehicle history document shown, and mileage is unrelated to this specific component's photo.
No close-up of seals, clips, or tamper marks on the housing to confirm it hasn't been disassembled.

risks.risk: Assembly may be incomplete (missing clips, bolts, sensors, or sub-components)
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set showing all mounting points, clips, and sensor ports

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or damage not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from top, bottom, and underside, plus a photo inside the housing

risks.risk: Wiring harness or connector pins could be damaged, corroded, or missing pins
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the connector pins and harness insulation
risks.if_unproven: priced as faulty wiring until shown intact

risks.risk: Compatibility unknown (no part number, engine size, or model match)
risks.proof: Clear photo of any stamped part number or OEM label on the housing
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, buyer assumes compatibility risk

risks.proof: Video of part being tested on a running engine or multimeter continuity check on sensor

proof_requests: Photos from multiple angles (top, bottom, side, inside housing)
Close-up of any part number, engine code, or OEM label
Close-up of wiring harness connector pins and housing seals/clips
Short video of the part installed and engine running, showing no warning lights
Photo of any import/customs documentation if claiming Tokunbo origin
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a used air intake/filter housing assembly, so it can be priced at worst case given the unverified origin, condition, and completeness claims.
